result_text:
The "Undefined Team" now collects only active unmatched contributors. The change is in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/landscape/analysis/LandscapeAnalysisResults.java`.

- **What was there:** the remainder check `belongsToUndefinedTeam` compared a `ContributorRepositories` list against an email string, so it was always true and every unmatched contributor was added.
- **What I changed:** the helper now returns `contributor.getContributor().isActive()`, which uses the 180-day threshold and treats a blank latest-commit date as active. I also dropped its unused second parameter and updated the call site and Javadoc.
- **Configured teams:** untouched. They still keep all members, active or not.

I ran `ContributorTest` in the codeanalyzer module and it passed. There is no existing test for the landscape team grouping, so the new filter itself is not covered by any test. I did not add one, to keep the change small. Nothing was committed.
